title: 第一章 神体觉醒夜
lines: “废物！就你也配姓林？！”
青石城，林家演武场。
林墨被一脚踹飞三丈远，身体狠狠砸在演武场边缘的青石柱上。肋骨断了三根，喉咙一甜，鲜血混着内脏碎片喷了出来。
“哈哈哈！看看他这狼狈样！”
“炼体三重？狗都比他强！”
周围响起肆无忌惮的嘲笑。
林墨艰难地抬起头，透过被血糊住的视线，看向踹飞他的那人——林家大少爷，林惊天。十八岁，炼体九重巅峰，林家百年不遇的天才。
“林墨，你爹当年偷了家族至宝潜逃，你就是个小偷的儿子。”林惊天走到他面前，居高临下，一脚踩在他的脸上，“今天家族大比，你若能接我三招，我就准你继续留在林家。现在才一招，你就趴下了？”
林墨的手指抠进青石板缝隙，指甲翻裂。
“我爹……没偷东西。”
“还敢嘴硬？”林惊天脚下用力，林墨的脸颊被碾进碎石里，血混着泥土，“你这种废物，留在林家就是耻辱。不如……”
他俯下身，压低声音，只有两人能听见：“不如我送你下去，和你那失踪多年的爹娘团聚？”
杀意！
林墨瞳孔骤缩。
这混蛋真要下死手！
他想挣扎，可炼体三重和炼体九重的差距，就像蚂蚁和大象。林惊天的脚像山一样压着他，灵力封锁了他所有经脉。
“住手！”
一道清脆女声响起。
演武场入口，一名白衣少女快步走来。十六七岁年纪，肤如凝脂，眸若星辰。她一出现，整个演武场都安静了。
林家三小姐，林清雪。
也是林墨的未婚妻——至少曾经是。
“惊天哥哥，家族大比点到为止，何必下这么重的手？”林清雪走到近前，语气平静，但眼底深处闪过一丝复杂。
林惊天看到林清雪，立刻换上一副笑脸：“清雪妹妹，你怎么来了？这种废物，不值得你关心。”
“他毕竟是我曾经的未婚夫。”林清雪淡淡道，“放了他吧。”
“未婚夫？”林惊天笑了，声音陡然提高，“清雪妹妹，你还不知道吧？昨晚家主已经答应，取消你和这废物的婚约！下个月，你就和我定亲！”
林清雪身体微微一颤。
林墨的脑袋嗡的一声。
婚约……取消了？
是了。三个月前，他从林家年轻一代第一天才，一夜之间修为全失，沦为炼体三重的废物。而林清雪，则觉醒了“冰灵体”，被青玄宗长老看中，收为亲传弟子。
一个天上，一个地下。
婚约解除，只是时间问题。
只是他没想到，会这么快。
“清雪……”林墨抬起头，想从她脸上看到一丝愧疚，一丝不舍。
但林清雪避开了他的目光。
她只是淡淡道：“惊天哥哥，即便如此，也无需取他性命。让他走吧。”
“走？”林惊天笑了，“好，我听清雪妹妹的。”
他抬起脚，踢了踢林墨：“滚吧。从今天起，你被逐出林家。再敢踏进青石城一步，我打断你的腿！”
林墨艰难地爬起来。
浑身是血，肋骨断了，内脏受损。但他站得很直。
他看向林清雪，一字一句：“三个月前，我在后山为你采冰心草，遭遇妖兽围攻，修为尽失。你说过，此生非我不嫁。”

content_en:
"Trash! Are you worthy of your last name Lin?!"

    Qingshi City, the Lin family's martial arts arena.

    Lin Mo was kicked three feet away, and his body hit the bluestone pillar at the edge of the martial arts field. Three ribs were broken, his throat felt sweet, and blood mixed with internal organs spurted out.

    "Hahaha! Look at how embarrassed he is!"

    "Third level of body refining? Dogs are stronger than him!"

    There was unbridled ridicule all around.

    Lin Mo raised his head with difficulty and looked at the man who kicked him away through his blood-covered eyes - Lin Jingtian, the eldest young master of the Lin family. Eighteen years old, at the peak of the ninth level of physical training, a genius that the Lin family has never seen in a century.

    "Lin Mo, your father stole the family treasure and fled. You are the son of a thief." Lin Jingtian walked up to him, condescendingly stepped on his face, "Today's family competition, if you can take three moves from me, I will allow you to stay in the Lin family. Now it's just one move, and you're lying down?"

    Lin Mo's fingers dug into the cracks of the bluestone and his nails cracked.

    "My dad... didn't steal anything."

    "You dare to speak harshly?" Lin Jingtian's foot was so strong that Lin Mo's cheek was crushed into the gravel, and the blood was mixed with the soil. "It would be a shame for a waste like you to stay in the Lin family. How about..."

    He leaned down and lowered his voice so that only the two of them could hear: "How about I send you down to reunite with your parents who have been missing for many years?"

    Killing intent!

    Lin Mo's pupils shrank suddenly.

    This bastard really wants to kill him!

    He wanted to struggle, but the gap between the third level of body refining and the ninth level of body refining was like an ant and an elephant. Lin Jingtian's feet pressed against him like a mountain, and his spiritual power blocked all his meridians.

    "Stop!"

    A clear female voice sounded.

    At the entrance of the martial arts arena, a girl in white walked quickly. At the age of sixteen or seventeen, his skin is like gelatin and his eyes are like stars. As soon as she appeared, the entire martial arts arena fell silent.

    The third young lady of the Lin family, Lin Qingxue.

    She is also Lin Mo's fiancée - at least she used to be.

    "Brother Jingtian, the family competition is over, why do you need to be so harsh?" Lin Qingxue walked closer, her tone was calm, but a hint of complexity flashed deep in her eyes.

    When Lin Jingtian saw Lin Qingxue, he immediately put on a smile and said, "Sister Qingxue, why are you here? This kind of trash is not worth your care."

    "He is my former fiancé after all." Lin Qingxue said lightly, "Let him go."

    "Fiancé?" Lin Jingtian smiled and his voice suddenly rose, "Sister Qingxue, you don't know yet, right? Last night the head of the family agreed to cancel your engagement with this loser! Next month, you will be engaged to me!"

    Boom——

    Lin Qingxue's body trembled slightly.

    Lin Mo's head buzzed.

    The engagement...cancelled?

    Yes. Three months ago, he went from being the first genius of the younger generation of the Lin family to losing all his cultivation overnight and becoming a waste at the third level of body refining. Lin Qingxue, on the other hand, awakened the "Ice Spirit Body" and was favored by the elder of Qingxuan Sect and accepted as his direct disciple.

    One is in heaven and the other is underground.

    It's only a matter of time before the engagement is broken off.

    But he didn't expect it to be so fast.

    "Qingxue..." Lin Mo raised his head, trying to see a trace of guilt and reluctance on her face.

    But Lin Qingxue avoided his gaze.

    She just said lightly: "Brother Jingtian, even so, there is no need to take his life. Let him go."

    "Leave?" Lin Jingtian smiled, "Okay, I listen to Sister Qingxue."

    He raised his foot and kicked Lin Mo: "Go away. From today on, you will be expelled from the Lin family. If you dare to step into Bluestone City again, I will break your legs!"

    Lin Mo got up with difficulty.

    He was covered in blood, his ribs were broken, and his internal organs were damaged. But he stood very straight.

    He looked at Lin Qingxue and said word by word: "Three months ago, I was collecting ice heart grass for you in the back mountain. I was besieged by monsters and lost all my cultivation. You said that you would not marry anyone but me in this life."
title_en: Chapter 1 The Night of Divine Body Awakening
